meta.aiUse: Built by pipeline code written with AI assistance (Claude Code), directed and reviewed by the team. See AI_USE.md.
meta.pairsNote: Side-by-side pairs asked for by the team. They are for showing two places at one scale and are not analog scores.
meta.projection: Local orthographic, centred on the item's lat/lon, north up. Pixel (0,0) is the north-west corner.
meta.description: Every extract covers the same ground area, so they can be shown side by side at one scale. Pixel size differs per dataset and is given per file; nothing is upsampled.
meta.imageNote: Mars images are daytime infrared (THEMIS), grey-scale. A lunar image that is at least 95% near-black (permanent shadow) is null.
